info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Management Customer Product-spec
info.description: The Customer Product Management API facilitates the creation and management of customer product specifications within a banking system. This API allows financial institutions to define and register products associated with their customers, ensuring that each product meets specific needs and compliance requirements. Typical consumers of this API include banking application developers and financial service providers aiming to enhance customer offerings. By employing this API, businesses can streamline their product management processes and improve customer engagement with tailored financial solutions.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new products associated with a customer. By providing the necessary product details, you can efficiently add products to the customer's profile in the management system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update customer products within the customer management system. It requires the relevant product details to be provided in a JSON format, which will be processed to manage the associated customer products.

201.description: Successfully created a new customer product.
